units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 133">Yalk. Gen. 133</cite> (quot. fr. Midr. Vayisu) <he>בכסא ימנית</he> (corr. acc.) in the right loin.—Pl. <he>כְּסָלִים</he>, <cite ref="K00948"><he>כְּסָלִין</he></cite>.
Tosef. Bekh. IV, 10 [read:] כל שכְּסָלָיו יוצאין a kasul is one whose loins protrude.
<cite ref="Shabbat 31b:5">Sabb. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>וישׁ להם חלב על הכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>כִּסְלָם</he>) and yet have fat on the groins (are careless).—Trnsf.

Yalk. Num. 742; Yalk. Ps. 819 quot. fr. Y’lamd. (v. Ar. s. v. כסל) כִּסְלָם … מחשבתם וכ׳ kislam (Ps. LXXVIII, 7) means their thought, as we read (Lev. III, 4, cmp. כִּלְיָה) ‘that which is by the loins’; (oth. opin.) טיפשותן it means their inactivity, as it is said (Koh. IV, 5) &c.; (oth. opin.) בטחונן their trust as we read (Job XXXI, 24) &c.
